papers.title_en: PACE-Mem: Prefix-Aware Complementary Evidence for Multimodal Agents
papers.authors: Shidu Ren, Rong-cheng Tu, Hang Zhou, Xiao Luo
papers.evidence: 面向多模态智能体的长期记忆证据检索与自适应深度
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体长期记忆含大量重复场景与实体，检索证据易重叠，固定深度也难适配问题。PACE-Mem面向片段式记忆，先查询引导池化打分，再用MMR构建互补证据序列，并由得分轨迹选择前缀长度以确定检索深度。在三个长视频基准和两个智能体框架上，它相较Adaptive-k平均提升1.6%问答准确率。该方法无需训练、可插拔，为片段式智能体记忆提供更稳健的证据检索方案。
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal agents accumulate experience, their long-term memories contain many similar observations of recurring scenes, actions, and entities. Answer quality depends on the evidence retrieved from these memories into the model's context. However, query-relevant memories may contain overlapping information, and a fixed retrieval depth may return too little or too much evidence for a given question. To address these challenges, we propose PACE-Mem, Prefix-Aware Complementary Evidence, which constructs a complementary evidence sequence and determines its length from the same selection trajectory. For structured memories, query-guided pooling combines records within each clip to obtain relevance scores and representations. Using these relevance scores and representations, maximal marginal relevance (MMR) selection balances query relevance against overlap with previously selected evidence. From the resulting score trajectory, a prefix-length selection algorithm determines retrieval depth by comparing length-normalized adjacent declines, accounting for both score changes and the amount of evidence accumulated. PACE-Mem is a training-free, plug-in retrieval method for clip-based agent memory systems, leaving memory construction and answer generation unchanged. Across three long-video benchmarks and two agent frameworks, PACE-Mem improves question-answering accuracy by an average of 1.6% over Adaptive-k, the strongest baseline at comparable mean retrieval depths. Further analysis reveals that jointly adding and removing evidence is associated with larger net accuracy gains than either change alone.

papers.title_en: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
papers.authors: Yutong Song, Jiang Wu, Yuxuan Ren, Tony Qin, Baoyuan Wang
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的回放与巩固外部记忆框架
papers.tldr: 针对LLM智能体不更新参数、仅靠外部记忆自我改进时，单次尝试经验难提取且长期累积会退化的问题，Hippo提出无训练的记忆框架：比较同一任务的多次尝试，识别可复用决策并细化适用条件，再与已有记忆合并重叠、消解冲突。在SWE-bench Verified、WebArena和Mind2Web上均取得性能提升，且保留经验数显著少于累积基线；不同能力基座模型均受益，说明基于记忆的适应对强模型仍有效。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson as a separate entry. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web show performance gains in all three settings and substantially fewer retained experiences than the accumulation baseline. The gains extend across the evaluated base models of varying capabilities, indicating that memory-based adaptation remains useful even for highly capable models.

papers.title_en: MemRevise: A Self-Revising Memory for Conversational Search
papers.authors: Mohammed Ali, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Adam Jatowt
papers.evidence: 可修订记忆图用于更新对话搜索历史
papers.tldr: 对话检索中用户会修正误解、改需求或回到旧话题，历史部分内容已不代表当前意图；现有基准未隔离此类回合，方法也缺少显式“丢弃”标记。论文提出CONVREVISE基准，覆盖六类返回/修订场景；并提出MEMREVISE，用可修订记忆图、3B写入器和记忆引导检索记录话题增删与恢复。冻结检索器下MRR@10达0.701，显著优于基线，说明可修订记忆有效。
papers.abstract_en: In conversational search, users correct misun-derstandings, revise their requests and return to earlier topics, so part of the history no longer reflects what they want. Existing benchmarks do not isolate such turns. Current search methods either re-read the history or keep a record of every turn, and none of them marks earlier content as dropped. We introduce CONVREVISE, a benchmark of 4,429 test questions in six tiers of returns and revisions over TopiOCQA, CORAL and OR-QuAC. We also propose MEMREVISE, which combines a revisable memory graph, a 3B writer distilled from teacher memories, and a search guided by the memory. The writer reads each turn once and adds a node that records its topic, its facts and the operations it performs, such as adding, abandoning or reactivating a topic. Topic status follows from these operations, so a dropped topic keeps its facts and can be restored. With a frozen retriever, MEMREVISE reaches a mean MRR@10 of 0.701, against 0.589 for the best competitor, ConvSearch-R1-FT, and 0.617 for a writer distilled the same way without the memory, so the memory and the steps built on it add 0.084. MEMREVISE is significantly better on Topi- OCQA and OR-QuAC, statistically tied with prompted 32B rewriters on CORAL, and never significantly behind the strongest competitor of any tier.

papers.title_en: M-Plan: Comprehensive Planning For LLM Agents with Memory Arrangement
papers.authors: Ziyang Liu, Jiakang Yuan, Jiayuan Fan, Tao Chen
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体规划的长时记忆编排与任务自适应检索
papers.tldr: LLM智能体在单轮任务表现突出，但长程任务仍受长上下文、持续决策与推理能力不足制约。M-Plan提出闭环多智能体框架，融合长短时记忆，以全局里程碑和局部提示形成全局—局部引导，并在任务后整理经验存入长期记忆。在ALFWorld、Webshop和PDDL上，多模型实验显示其准确率与效率均优于基线，且保持即插即用设计。该设计区别于单一长期或短期记忆方案。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated outstanding performance in single-turn tasks, yet they continue to struggle with long-horizon tasks, particularly in environments without prior training. A key limitation of single LLMs is their difficulty in processing long contexts, which stems from weaknesses in continuous decision-making and reasoning capabilities. Although existing multi-agent systems (MAS) equipped with long-term memory bases can partially address this gap, they mostly rely on knowledge reuse or summarization, an approach that is often constrained by directly retrieval without any adaptation for the current task, while the retrieved memory may contain much history noises waiting to be preprocessed. In contrast, MAS characterized by task-specific guidance often lack long-term memory specifically designed for the guidance. To address these challenges, we propose M-Plan, a closed-loop MAS framework that integrates long-term and short-term memory. By combining global-local and past-current guidance, M-Plan enhances agents' performance on multi-turn tasks while maintaining a plug-and-play design. During task execution, agents receive task-specific milestones and insights, and are provided with local hints only when confusion arises, which form global-local guidance together. These guidance generation and utilization construct the short-term memory as well. After task completion, relevant information about the current task is optimized or reorganized before being sent to the long-term memory storage for future retrieval. The designments mentioned above build a comprehensive framework different from other individual long-term or short-term memory works. Extensive experiments on multi-turn tasks including ALFWorld, Webshop, and PDDL across diverse models demonstrate that M-Plan outperforms multiple baseline methods in both accuracy and efficiency.

papers.title_en: MemDev-Bench: Does Memory Help Code Agents?Benchmarking Memory Systems over Real Repository Histories
papers.authors: Guorui Chen, Tao Liu, Zhenzhen Huang, Yidan Zhang, Liyu Jiang, Shuoyuan Wang, Hanchen Sun, Xu He, Dong Li, Yihan Hu, Jianye Hao, Lei Feng
papers.evidence: 评测智能体记忆系统如何组织与复用历史经验的基准
papers.tldr: 代码智能体需要在持续演化的真实仓库中复用经验，但现有基准缺少时间有效历史与先验任务相关性控制。MemDev-Bench为每个任务配对同仓库、带相关性标注的早期任务，并自动生成可执行可验证的4,869个历史任务，覆盖555个基础任务。系统评测发现，记忆主要提升细粒度定位与编辑及功能正确性，也会因未重估适用性导致可解任务失败，且直接提供原始轨迹比记忆系统更省步骤。该基准揭示了记忆系统的收益与风险，并指出应保留过程信息、按当前上下文重估记忆适用性。
papers.abstract_en: Code agents increasingly work on evolving real repositories, and memory systems aim to help them reuse earlier experience. However, such experience is diverse and evolving, so it remains unclear how memory systems organize it and thereby affect code agents. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this reliably because they lack either temporally valid histories or control over prior-task relevance. In this paper, we present MemDev-Bench to evaluate how memory systems affect code agents over diverse repository histories. It pairs each task with relevance-annotated earlier tasks from the same repository to build histories with controlled relevance. We also build an automated pipeline that reliably makes these earlier tasks executable and verifiable, producing 4,869 historical tasks for 555 base tasks. Based on MemDev-Bench, our systematic evaluation of memory systems across diverse development scenarios yields three main findings. (1) Memory mainly improves fine-grained localization and editing, increasing functional correctness. (2) Memory also causes failures on otherwise solvable tasks even with related history, and unrelated history tends to increase such failures. These failures mainly stem from agents reusing memory without reassessing its applicability. (3) Compared with using memory systems, directly providing agents with raw historical trajectories substantially reduces their steps. Further analysis suggests that agents save these steps by reusing process information that compressed memories tend to omit. These results suggest that future memory systems should preserve process information and reassess memory applicability against current task context.

papers.title_en: The Value of Memory in Language Agents
papers.authors: Zehao Lin, Erenkai Zhu, Helan Hu, Xixuan Hao, Chunyu Li, Kai Chen
papers.evidence: 用决策论框架量化语言智能体记忆的价值
papers.tldr: 语言智能体的记忆价值取决于哪些区分能留存、受限智能体能否使用、需求变化时能否恢复或修订。论文提出决策论框架，将原始历史到持久状态、操作使用及高成本恢复与修订串成价值链条，以任务损失避免量度量原始与保留价值，并给出风险—成本前沿和价值剖面。模拟与五个最小反例揭示信息时机、检索访问、组件交互、反馈与需求不确定性的作用；诊断实验显示记忆在保存、使用和测量上均会失效。
papers.abstract_en: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers describe attainable recovery and preservation across uses. Unknown demand yields value profiles, while interactive feedback changes the distribution of future work. A cost-aware simulation condition and five minimal counterexamples expose the roles of information timing, retrieval access, component interaction, feedback and demand uncertainty. In particular, a pointer with zero mutual information about the answer can still reduce the cost of exact recovery. Diagnostics on LoCoMo, a two-project update task and longitudinal cases exhibit failures of preservation, use and measurement. At fixed retrieved evidence, a saved ledger changes subsequent answers; at fixed agent outputs, an evaluator revision changes scores. The framework connects these distinctions to operational risk bounds and testable principles for allocating memory, preserving recovery options and revising evidence dependencies.

papers.title_en: Subgoal-aware Memory Graph for GUI Agent
papers.authors: Dezhao Luo, Daniel Beechey, Derek Yuen, Weilin Luo
papers.evidence: 为GUI智能体蒸馏历史轨迹的子目标感知记忆图
papers.tldr: GUI智能体在长程移动界面任务中需要复用历史经验，但单动作记忆语义不足，整轨迹记忆又难跨任务复用。本文提出子目标感知记忆图，将连续且共享意图的动作切分为子目标，并把子目标经验组织为可合并、扩展和检索的图节点。在SPA-Bench上，该方法相较基线将成功率提升11.11%。它为GUI智能体提供了结构化、可复用的经验表示。
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents aim to automate complex user tasks by interacting with mobile interfaces, but ef- fective decision-making in long-horizon set- tings requires reusing prior experience rather than relying solely on the environment ob- servations. Existing memory-based methods typically store experience either at the single- action level or as entire trajectories. Single- step actions are often too fine-grained to carry meaningful semantics, since the success of an individual action does not necessarily imply progress towards the overall goal. In contrast, whole trajectories are often too coarse-grained and difficult to reuse across different tasks. We propose a subgoal-aware memory graph that distils past trajectories into structured, reusable evidence at the level of subgoals. We define a subgoal as consecutive actions shar- ing a single intent, the granularity at which progress toward the task becomes meaning- ful. To reduce redundancy and support cross- task reuse, we organise subgoal experiences as nodes in a graph, where related memories can be merged, extended, and retrieved based on the environment observation. On SPA-Bench, our method improves success rate by 11.11% over the baseline.

papers.evidence: 评估记忆压缩整合与删除生命周期的基准
papers.tldr: 现有语言智能体长期记忆基准多评估信息检索与复用，却忽略记忆应保持原样、压缩、合并还是删除的表示决策。作者形式化记忆生命周期评估并提出VitaBench，用重复记忆审查与全时域反事实评估衡量这些决策。基准含诊断层与自然层，显示生命周期余量约1.36/1.41，过半状态在短时域与全时域下偏好动作改变。学习型延迟策略在自然层达101.5联合效用，优于最佳固定策略83.4，表明检索与持久化决策是不同评估问题。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory benchmarks for language agents primarily evaluate whether information from earlier interactions can be retrieved and used when relevant. Persistent memory systems face an additional problem before future use is known: deciding whether a memory should remain exact, be compressed, consolidated, or deleted. Existing benchmarks capture long-range retrieval, temporal reasoning, evidence reuse, and incremental interaction, but do not directly evaluate these earlier representation decisions. We formalize memory lifecycle evaluation and introduce VitaBench, a benchmark that makes lifecycle decisions measurable through repeated memory reviews and full-horizon counterfactual evaluation. VitaBench contains a controlled Diagnostic tier that isolates future-use patterns and a Naturalistic tier that composes them into generated customer-service-style interaction streams. We characterize lifecycle decision structure with three diagnostics: lifecycle headroom, measuring the advantage of adaptive choices over the best fixed strategy; horizon reversal, measuring when short-horizon decisions change under delayed consequences; and optimal-action diversity, measuring whether different memory states favor different lifecycle operations. Across both tiers, VitaBench exhibits substantial lifecycle structure: lifecycle headroom is 1.364 in Diagnostic and 1.405 in Naturalistic, and 60.2% and 56.5% of states, respectively, change their preferred action between short and full horizons. A learned delayed lifecycle policy further improves over the best fixed strategy on VitaBench-Naturalistic, reaching 101.5 versus 83.4 joint utility. These results show that retrieving past information and deciding how it should persist are distinct evaluation problems, and that lifecycle management requires evaluation of the delayed consequences of representation decisions.

papers.title_en: Retrieving Complementary Evidence for Multi-Hop RAG with Semantic Gain Graphs
papers.authors: Zeliang Li, Xiaofen Xing, Kailing Guo, Xiangmin Xu
papers.evidence: 基于语义增益图为多跳RAG检索互补证据
papers.tldr: 多跳RAG需联合互补证据，但查询相关性与图连通性无法直接衡量文档间的额外信息贡献。SG²RAG离线用大模型评估语义近邻内文档块的条件增益，聚合成对称边权并构建可复用语义增益图。在线以查询相关种子启动受控Personalized PageRank，排序初始集合之外的互补证据。在MuSiQue、2Wiki和HotpotQA上，其平均EM、F1与Recall@10优于所比较的单次检索方法，显示显式建模证据互补性的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires finding documents whose evidence is useful in combination. Query relevance and graph connectivity help locate related content, but neither directly measures the additional information one document contributes given another. We introduce SG$^2$RAG, a framework that represents this complementarity through semantic gain. Offline, a large language model assesses the relevant and nonredundant information contributed by one chunk given another within neighborhoods proposed by semantic similarity. These ordered assessments are aggregated into symmetric edge weights to construct a reusable Semantic Gain Graph. Online, controlled Personalized PageRank starts from query-relevant seeds and ranks complementary evidence beyond the initial retrieval set. Experiments on MuSiQue, 2Wiki, and HotpotQA with two language model backbones show that SG$^2$RAG achieves the best average EM, F1, and Recall@10 among the evaluated single-retrieval methods. Under identical candidate support and propagation, semantic gain improves average F1 and Recall@10 over similarity weighting by 4.08 and 4.31 points. Analyses of supporting documents and improvements in three iterative retrieval frameworks further support its effectiveness as a reusable retrieval component.

papers.title_en: Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Bofan Xie, Chaokun Wang, Guanchen Ge, Songyao Wang, Fang Niu, Hang Zhang, Wei Wang
papers.evidence: LLM智能体记忆遗忘与更新基准
papers.tldr: LLM智能体的长期记忆会积累敏感或过时信息，用户要求删除时，记忆系统需精准移除目标并保留其余内容。为此作者提出首个记忆遗忘基准Bemula，含50个多轮对话、135个遗忘请求和1742个测试问题，并用配对控制版本评估存储、移除、保留、重学与抗抽取。评测六种主流记忆系统和三种主干LLM后发现，没有系统端到端通过超过1.5%的遗忘请求，多数完全失败。这表明智能体记忆遗忘仍是开放难题，Bemula为后续设计提供了专门评测基准。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated. To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. Across the paired versions, five test suites measure storage, removal of the requested information, preservation of unrelated memories, relearning of similar facts, and resistance to extraction attacks. On Bemula, we evaluate six mainstream memory systems under three backbone LLMs, together with the Full Context LLM on two of them. The results are negative. Across all evaluated systems and backbones, no system passes more than 1.5% of forget requests end to end, and most pass none at all. These systems either leave the requested information extractable under simple attacks or delete far more than requested. Memory unlearning therefore remains an open challenge for agent memory design. We release our data and code at https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark.

papers.title_en: Memorizing Who, Knowing How: Benchmarking Personal and Procedural Memory for Persistent Assistants
papers.authors: Maosheng Qin, Qi Zhang, Mingxuan Xia, Jinglei Chen, Jiexiang Wang, Sheng Guo, Cheng Peng, Haobo Wang
papers.evidence: 面向持久助理智能体的个人与程序性记忆基准
papers.tldr: 持久个人助手不仅要记住用户是谁，还要知道如何行动，但现有基准常把个人记忆与程序记忆分开评估。本文提出PraxisMemBench，覆盖日常生活与工作轨迹，让两类记忆共同演化并形成相互依赖。方法上提出PraxisMem，利用特权联合状态监督、位置感知GRPO和动态残差路由OPSD，把记忆内容与组织维护能力内化到记忆管理器。实验显示其总体会话成功率达40.78%，远高于Claude Code原生记忆的20.60%；同时关系相关失败随交互历史增长而上升，说明长期持续维护是核心挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems for persistent personal agents must move beyond isolated memories, maintaining both personal memory about whom they serve and procedural memory about how to act. Crucially, in harness-based personal assistance, procedures or skills are inherently user-conditioned: personal context determines which procedures apply, how they are instantiated, and when they should change. Existing benchmarks typically emphasize either personal or procedural memory, leaving their interaction underexplored. We introduce PraxisMemBench, a harness-based benchmark for persistent personal assistance across daily-life and work trajectories, where personal and procedural memory evolve together and later tasks depend on both. Experiments show that maintaining two memory types separately is insufficient, with completion dropping from single-type to interdependent dependencies (84.6% to 77.9%). More broadly, across existing methods, relation-related failures increase from early to late sessions as interaction history grows (59.8% to 72.9%), revealing a continual-maintenance challenge: writing correct memories is not enough if their evolving content and organization cannot be preserved for later retrieval. To address this, we propose PraxisMem, which uses privileged joint-state supervision to internalize the ability to maintain memory content and organization into the memory manager, with location-aware GRPO and dynamic residual-routed OPSD. PraxisMem reaches 40.78% overall Session Success Rate, compared with 20.60% for Claude Code's native memory. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QMMMS/PraxisMemBench.

papers.title_en: SteerSearch: Interactive Search Reasoning with Mid-Response Steering
papers.authors: Udit Thakur, Baohao Liao, Matteo Nulli, Stefan Vasilev, Seyyed Hadi Hashemi, Shahram Khadivi, Christof Monz
papers.evidence: 检索证据需跟随更新后查询目标的交互式搜索推理
papers.tldr: 搜索增强模型常作长程研究代理，但开放训练默认目标全程固定，难以处理搜索中途改目标，并出现“答案目标锚定”：检索新证据却仍答旧问题。作者提出SteerSearch，用注入干预的交互轨迹做强化学习，训练模型保留上下文并重设目标，构建基准并探索CCR奖励。无CCR时，Qwen2.5-3B转向准确率从11.1%升至31.3%，Qwen3-4B从36.6%升至44.6%，且保持单查询性能。
papers.abstract_en: Search-augmented language models increasingly serve as long-horizon research agents, yet most open training methods assume a fixed user goal throughout search. We study mid-response steering, where users redirect a model during ongoing reasoning or retrieval. We identify answer-target anchoring, a failure mode in which fixed-query search agents retrieve evidence for the updated request but still answer an earlier question. We introduce SteerSearch, an RL framework that trains on interactive search trajectories with injected interventions to enable context-preserving target reassignment, and SteerSearch-Bench, a benchmark adapted from multi-hop QA datasets. We also investigate Contrastive Context Reward (CCR), an auxiliary signal for aligning post-intervention reasoning with the updated goal. Without CCR, SteerSearch improves average steering accuracy over Search-R1 from 11.1% to 31.3% on Qwen2.5-3B and from 36.6% to 44.6% on Qwen3-4B, while preserving standard single-query performance. Gains also extend to larger Qwen2.5 models and natural multi-turn conversations.

papers.title_en: What should AI forget? A design and taxonomy for negative space governance in AI memory
papers.authors: Eryue Xu, Ke Ding, Ting-Yu Chang, Tianshi Li, Masooda Bashir
papers.evidence: 策略级记忆闸门，控制哪些信息进入AI记忆并在对话中被遗忘
papers.tldr: AI记忆带来个性化，但用户希望部分已披露信息被遗忘，现有事后管理难以界定保护边界。作者基于146名用户报告的179起事件，构建15类信息分类法，并实现策略级记忆门控FENCE，自动阻止受保护对话进入记忆且允许逐案覆盖。用户研究显示FENCE在可用性、可解释性和信任度上优于传统管理。该工作提出以分类规则治理AI不应记住的内容。
papers.abstract_en: AI memory personalizes assistants, yet users want some disclosed information forgotten. We characterize the negative space of AI memory, where protection should take precedence over potential future personalization benefits. From 179 incidents reported by 146 users, we developed a taxonomy of 15 information categories users want excluded from memory, revealing sensitivity concerns beyond conventional taxonomies. We operationalize this taxonomy in FENCE, a policy-level memory gate that automatically applies user-selected category-based rules to subsequent conversations, preventing information from protected conversations from entering AI memory by default while allowing case-by-case overrides. In a within-subjects study (N=15), participants described FENCE as making memory governance more usable, interpretable, and trustworthy than conventional post-hoc management. Our findings demonstrate how taxonomy-based rules can potentially support user-defined memory boundaries. We call for collective efforts to establish policies governing what AI should not remember, rather than leaving protection to individual retrospective management.

papers.title_en: GARRET: Generative Feedback for Region Retrieval in Visual Documents
papers.authors: Weijian Jian, Siyang Chen, Yuguang Yang, Yajun Zhang, Chunyu Xie, Dawei Leng, Yuhui Yin
papers.evidence: 面向视觉文档多模态RAG的区域级检索
papers.tldr: 视觉文档检索多以整页为粒度，难返回细粒度证据，区域级训练又依赖昂贵或噪声标注。GARRET 仅用页面-问题-答案三元组，通过可微生成反馈训练共享检索器：页面与区域多向量打分形成软路由，辅助视觉语言模型聚合区域上下文并生成答案，为区域表示分配查询相关信用。推理移除辅助模型，并复用区域表示与页面摘要令牌构建紧凑页面表示。在 ViDoRe-V3-Region 上 macro nDCG@10 达 0.4126，超最强视觉基线 2.94 分；页面检索与 ColQwen2.5-v0.2 相当且每页索引向量少 47.8%。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation over visually rich documents requires evidence at a finer granularity than entire pages. Existing visual retrievers typically index or return full pages, whereas training region-level retrievers often requires costly query-to-region annotations or noisy model-generated labels. We introduce GARRET, a region-retrieval framework trained from (page, question, answer) triplets through differentiable generative feedback. A shared context-preserving retriever produces page and region multi-vector representations. During training, their retrieval scores define a soft routing distribution over candidate region crops. An auxiliary vision-language model attends to each crop separately, aggregates crop-specific contexts using the routing weights, and predicts the question followed by the answer under a next-token prediction objective. Gradients through the routing distribution assign query-conditioned credit to the indexed region representations, without requiring query-to-region annotations. At inference, the auxiliary model is removed. GARRET also reuses the contextualized region representations, together with page summary tokens, to construct a compact page representation. We introduce ViDoRe-V3-Region, a corpus-wide benchmark containing 200,682 fixed candidate regions across eight domains. GARRET achieves a macro nDCG@10 of 0.4126, outperforming the strongest visual baseline by 2.94 points. On page retrieval, it remains comparable to ColQwen2.5-v0.2 while indexing 47.8% fewer vectors per page.

papers.title_en: Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory
papers.authors: Masahiro Kaneko, Hiromi Arai, Timothy Baldwin
papers.evidence: 具备持久记忆的LLM智能体及其跨会话隐私泄漏
papers.tldr: LLM智能体用持久记忆提升个性化，但记忆中的个人属性可能泄露。论文通过多会话模拟，让带24项属性的模拟用户与是否查询记忆的客服智能体对话，并从完整记录推断属性。结果显示记忆提高回复质量也放大实测泄露，且随会话扩大；原因是记忆条件回复把旧值作为预设带入，用户确认或未纠正后形成自我强化循环。贡献是揭示该隐私循环，并表明在智能体回复端禁止陈述或预设属性可在保留大部分质量增益的同时把泄露降至近无记忆水平。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use persistent memory to personalize responses, and personal attributes in this memory pose a privacy risk if exposed. We ask how consulting memory during dialogue changes what users go on to say, and thus what the memory comes to reveal. In multi-session simulations, a simulated user with 24 personal attributes talks with a support agent that does or does not consult memory, and in both settings attributes are inferred from the full accumulated record. Across four support models, memory raises response quality but also empirical leakage, the share of attribute values correctly inferred from the record, by a margin that widens over sessions. The cause is a loop in ordinary, non-adversarial assistance. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or leave them uncorrected, so that cues and the agent's own guesses become recorded values. The loop reinforces itself, and removing the agent's mentions of an attribute lowers its later disclosure about twice as much as single-turn effects predict. Users cannot leave it on their own, since correcting a value discloses the attribute, declining to discuss it shifts later predictions toward sensitive values, and incorrect values left in place become entrenched. The loop is best weakened at the agent's response. Instructing the agent not to state or presuppose attributes brings leakage to about the no-memory level while keeping most of the quality gains, whereas filtering or anonymizing what users say or what is stored gives up much of them.

papers.title_en: Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents
papers.evidence: LLM智能体中的状态跟踪与推理保留
papers.tldr: LLM智能体常在行动前推理，但当正确行动依赖不断变化的状态时，推理与行动的关系仍不明确。论文构建文件锁任务，用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.5-9B分离每步生成推理与提示中保留旧推理的作用。结果显示，减少违规命令主要靠行动时生成推理，保留旧推理帮助有限；错误历史的推理还会误导行动。无推理时激活可解码状态，却无法预测哪些干预改变行为，说明推理的价值在计算而非记忆。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model's activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent's actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.

papers.title_en: The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents
papers.authors: Ruiyang Ren, Yuhao Wang, Yinan Zhang, Chunyan Miao
papers.evidence: 研究异步结果投递如何塑造搜索智能体的证据获取
papers.tldr: 并行搜索智能体在异步获取证据时，结果到达时序会改变其后续检索决策，即使初始证据完全相同；这种影响可延续到后续搜索。作者提出Confluent Evidence Acquisition（CEA），按子问题证据完备性释放局部推理，并将共享搜索分配与完成顺序解耦。实验显示CEA把获取分歧降至重复波动1.0个百分点内，准确率接近完整输入对照，并优于早提交最多12.6个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.

papers.authors: Himank Handa, Negar Arabzadeh, Matei Zaharia
papers.evidence: 面向检索流程的多向量检索架构，降低存储与比较开销
papers.tldr: 多向量检索模型如ColBERT通过token级匹配常优于同等规模单向量模型，但为每个token保留向量会显著增加存储并拖慢检索，限制可扩展性。FLINT采用注意力池化，将查询和文档对称地表示为固定数量的嵌入向量，从而控制文档存储和检索时的向量比较次数。在BEIR上其排序效果与最接近基线相当，并在BrowseComp+、CRUMB、TREC Tip-of-the-Tongue 2025等长复杂查询基准上更优。长查询语料上端到端检索比ConstBERT快1.5-2.8倍，索引比ColBERTv2小5.3-9.3倍，并在BERT与ModernBERT骨干上验证了有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT often outperform single-vector models of comparable scale by matching queries and documents at the token level. However, retaining a vector for every token substantially increases storage requirements and slows retrieval compared to single-vector bi-encoders, limiting their scalability. We introduce FLINT (Fixed-budget Late INTeraction), an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to represent each query and document with a fixed number of embedding vectors. Unlike architectures that pool only document representations while retaining token-level queries, FLINT applies pooling symmetrically to both sides, limiting document storage and the number of vector comparisons needed during retrieval. FLINT achieves comparable ranking effectiveness to the closest baselines on BEIR and outperforms them on several benchmarks with longer and more complex queries, including BrowseComp+, CRUMB, and TREC Tip-of-the-Tongue 2025. We demonstrate that FLINT's effectiveness-efficiency benefits extend across encoder architectures, testing it on two separate backbones (BERT and ModernBERT). On long-query corpora, FLINT delivers 1.5-2.8 times faster end-to-end retrieval than ConstBERT, the closest baseline. FLINT also reduces index size by 5.3-9.3 times relative to token-level late-interaction models such as ColBERTv2.

papers.title_en: RANGER: Retrieval Agent for Navigating Graphs with Semantic Evaluation Rewards
papers.authors: Artem Mikhaylov, Pavel Konoplev, Nikolay Efanov, Artyom Sorokin, Evgeny Burnaev
papers.evidence: LLM引导的强化学习检索智能体在知识图谱上做多跳问答
papers.tldr: 多跳知识图谱问答需要精确多步导航，LLM语义理解强但结构化导航弱，RL擅长导航却难获得语义奖励。RANGER让LLM在训练中担任导师，为基于Transformer策略和GRPO训练的图检索智能体提供路径语义相关性密集奖励。在开放问答数据集上，它优于经典图搜索RAG与启发式奖励RL基线，NLP指标和LLM评审得分显著提升。该工作说明将LLM深度融入RL训练循环能产生更语义对齐的检索策略。
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning offers a promising direction for complex sequential decision-making tasks, such as multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs. While LLMs provide strong semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, they often struggle with precise, multi-step navigation in structured environments. Conversely, RL agents excel at learning navigation policies but are hindered by the difficulty of designing semantically meaningful reward functions. This paper introduces a novel hybrid approach in which an LLM serves as a mentor to an RL agent during training by providing dense, semantically informed reward signals. The RL agent, built on a Transformer-based policy and trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization, learns to navigate a knowledge graph to retrieve relevant information. The LLM evaluates the semantic relevance of the agent's traversed paths, generating reward signals that align the agent's behavior with the information needs expressed in a query. We integrate this Retrieval Agent for Navigating Graphs with Semantic Evaluation Rewards (RANGER) into a complete question-answering pipeline and evaluate it on the open question answering datasets. Experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms both a baseline retrieval-augmented system with classical graph search and one using an RL agent trained with heuristic rewards, achieving a significant increase in NLP metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scores. Our findings demonstrate that deep integration of LLMs into the RL training loop yields more effective and semantically aligned retrieval policies for complex reasoning tasks.
